doc.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Joining Basie and life on the bus
title: First night with Basie: rehearsal at the Woodside and no audition
summary: He cannot recall his first date, remembers a rehearsal at the Woodside Hotel and no audition.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Do you remember what your first night was like, getting up there with Basie?
I was so excited I didn’t even give a damn. I was so excited.
You remember where it was?
We had a little rehearsal at the Woodside and he just told me to come on, find you a note, whatever they played.
The first night, did anyone hand you a book of any kind?
No.
So how the hell did you play anything?
Well, that’s when I got kind of disgusted. And the next night, they would play some things that they didn’t play the first night.
Do you remember where this was?

The first date I played with Basie was, that’s an interesting question….it was a one­ nighter someplace, I can’t remember where it was. I’ve got to find that out because that’s an interesting question.
We’ll look at that when I bring that book tomorrow, we’ll check that and see if anything rings a bell from that period.
Is it a list from 1938?
Everything.
Oh yeah, I could remember that.
Alright, well we’ll take a look at that tomorrow.
Quite an interesting question, because I know it was unforgettable.
What about your audition?
No.
No audition?
Just had a rehearsal.
Just a rehearsal at the Woodside…well what kind of rehearsal, if they had no music, what was the rehearsal like?
